mode: Built-in image generation + Figma editable vector
concepts: A tall softly rounded open doorway symbol: one thick continuous warm ivory arch with squared bottom and a small perfectly circular ivory dot suspended at its center. Opening in the charcoal arch negative space evokes entering a quiet focus room. A single sculptural mark, not a bus, not an airplane. Very restrained architectural proportions. Pure warm ivory #F4F1E9 on deep charcoal #191919.

A beautiful continuous warm ivory path with TWO broad smooth right-angle rounded bends, forming a compact abstract lowercase f-like route, and a single round amber endpoint at the upper right. This is a distinctive route-to-completion brand mark, not a map drawing: exactly one thick path and one destination dot, no pin, no road lane markings, no extra lines. Warm ivory and tiny amber #DCAF62 on deep charcoal #191919.

One very bold nearly complete charcoal circular ring, with a generous opening at upper right, and one charcoal solid dot poised in that gap, visually continuing the circle. A refined progress-to-arrival emblem that hints at a whole focus session. Ring stroke substantial, dot clean, optically spaced rather than crowded. Charcoal #202020 on warm off-white #F4F1E9. No clock hands or ticks.

An original abstract companion mark built from TWO thick interlocking smoothly bent ribbon strokes: together they form a subtle lowercase m / twin sheltered arches, like two parallel journeys supporting one another. Sculptural, compact, elegant soft geometry, a single memorable joined silhouette with one narrow negative-space channel. Not a literal letter or people pictogram, no dots for heads. Warm ivory #F4F1E9 on muted deep forest green #324D43.
